title: Performance regression
prompt: Compare two application versions using completion rate, latency, token usage, and estimated spending.
scope: Exercise actual local runtime controls and owned fixtures. Live mode verifies the corresponding model/tool behavior with native evidence. Local success does not certify live inference.
